Subject: Disconnected site activation — artifact signing, courier acceptance, and rollback triggers

Andre / NeoHealth ops team,

Per our onboarding call, were planning the disconnected-site activation for the appliance bundle next week. We need to confirm a few items before the courier departs:

- Manifest and signing: Redwood will deliver a signed-manifest.json (detached JWS) plus a signer audit PDF. Please confirm the fingerprint for your HSM / root key that youll use to verify signatures on arrival. We used RSASSA-PSS w/ sha256 in this build.
- Transport: courier will hand off sealed media and a tamper-evident manifest; tracker will be shared by IronWheels.
- Acceptance tests: remote verification steps (artifact checksum, KMS public key thumbprint) must be completed inside the 4-hour acceptance window after handoff.
- Rollback triggers: list the conditions under which you will refuse activation and request return (checksum mismatch, missing signatures, operator mismatch).

Attachments Im including in this message: signed-manifest.json (detached-jws), installer-checksum.txt, and a sample courier handoff stub.

Next steps: please reply with your HSM public key fingerprint and a single-point-of-contact (name & mobile) for the receiving operator. If youd like a short runbook call prior to courier arrival, we can schedule a 20-minute walkthrough.

Thanks,
Ben

Subject: Re: Disconnected site activation — artifact signing, courier acceptance, and rollback triggers

Andre — thanks for the fingerprint and clarifying Qs. Quick answers and operational notes below.

1) Chain delivery: we include the full signer chain as a separate PEM file in the package (signer-chain.pem) and embed a pointer to it in signed-manifest.json. The courier will carry both. On arrival, operators should:
   - Verify signer-chain.pem signature and compare the top-level cert fingerprint against our published trust-anchor (https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/neohealth-offline-activation).
   - Verify detached JWS against the artifacts (we include a verification script in the installer bundle).

2) Mismatch policy: Redwoods standard procedure for checksum/signature mismatch is to NOT re-sign on-site. We require quarantine and return of media. We can schedule a vetted reissue after root-cause analysis. Exceptions require explicit ops leadership approval (eg. if courier damaged packaging but signature chain intact). We note this in the acceptance runbook.

Operational checklist (we will attach a one-page printed checklist inside the courier):
- Confirm courier seal intact and chain-of-custody PDF matches tracking number.
- Compute SHA256 of installer images; compare to installer-checksum.txt.
- Verify detached JWS using signer-chain.pem.
- Confirm operator identity against the POC and photo ID.
- Execute basic boot validation in isolated VLAN: service reaches local health endpoint, KV store mounts read-only.

Attachments in this thread: signer-chain.pem (PEM), courier-chain-of-custody.pdf, acceptance-runbook.md (text). Ive also added a short emergency rollback flow describing the signals that should trigger return vs quarantine.

Kimberly — Im looping you for the canary activation schedule and whether we want telemetry gating even in this disconnected flow.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Manager, Private Deployments

Subject: Re: Disconnected site activation — artifact signing, courier acceptance, and rollback triggers

Thanks everyone — short status and confirmed plan:

- Courier pickup scheduled: 2027-06-09 02:00 UTC (IronWheels) — tracking will be sent to Andre and ops+infra.
- Acceptance window: 4 hours from handoff; NeoHealth ops will validate exactly as Marissa outlined.
- Canary activation: we propose activating a single rack (node-01) for 2 hours in isolated VLAN after verification. No telemetry will be sent to Redwood until explicit opt-in; we will provide a local smoke test report via encrypted USB if youd like.
- Rollback triggers agreed: checksum mismatch, missing signer-chain.pem, operator identity fail, or manifest mismatch — in all cases quarantine and return unless otherwise authorized.

Action items:
- Andre: confirm you received signer-chain.pem and courier PDF when IronWheels sends the tracker.
- Kimberly / Karthik: prepare the one-page acceptance checklist PDF and include an emergency-contact phone list. Kimberly, please confirm you can have the checklist finalized by 2027-06-08 23:00 UTC.

If there are no objections Ill mark this thread as the formal acceptance plan and attach the signed manifest and courier label to the DocuSign envelope for signatures tomorrow.

Ben
